principles.heading: Core Engineering Principles
principles.intro: The frameworks and mental models I use to navigate complex technical landscapes.

reliability-first.title: Reliability First
reliability-first.desc: Designing systems that fail gracefully. Observability and monitoring are baked into the architecture from day one.

decoupled-architecture.title: Decoupled Architecture
decoupled-architecture.desc: Embracing modularity to allow components to evolve independently without risking systemic collapse.

performance-budgeting.title: Performance Budgeting
performance-budgeting.desc: Treating latency as a feature. Every kilobyte and millisecond counts in modern high-scale applications.

self-documenting-code.title: Self-Documenting Code
self-documenting-code.desc: Writing clear, expressive code that communicates intent. Comments are for "why", code is for "how".
